      children: "每个 NodeGroup 都在独立的快照副本中完成模拟。能够放置待调度 Pod 的方案，随后交给 Estimator 和 Expander 比较。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "nodegroup-候选与节点数估算",
      children: "NodeGroup 候选与节点数估算"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ScaleUp"
      }), " 为每个可用 NodeGroup 生成候选，调用关系可以写成："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "待调度 Pod\n  └─ BuildPodGroups\n      └─ 对每个可扩容 NodeGroup\n          ├─ SchedulablePodGroups\n          │   └─ 模板节点 + ClusterSnapshot.CheckPredicates\n          └─ ComputeExpansionOption\n              └─ Estimator.Estimate\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "NodeGroup 会在这些条件下被跳过："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["已达到 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "MaxSize"
        }), "；"]
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "NodeGroup 不存在、正在 backoff 或云侧状态不健康；"
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["触及 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "--max-nodes-total"
        }), "、CPU、内存或 GPU 的集群级上限；"]
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "模板节点无法容纳任何待调度 Pod；"
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "NodeGroup 的特定配置不允许当前扩容方式。"
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这个 tag 的默认 estimator 是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "binpacking"
      }), "。它按近似的 First-Fit Decreasing 方式处理 Pod equivalence group：先放入已有的模拟节点，放不下时继续添加模板节点，直到 Pod 被容纳或确认无法容纳。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Estimator 返回 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "expander.Option"
      }), "，其中包含 NodeGroup、预计新增节点数和可以放置的 Pod。节点数由 Estimator 计算，Expander 只在有效的 Option 之间选择 NodeGroup："]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "least-waste"
        }), "：默认策略，倾向于剩余资源浪费较少的方案；"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "most-pods"
        }), "：一次放置更多 Pod；"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "least-nodes"
        }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "priority"
        }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "price"
        }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "random"
        }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "grpc"
        }), "：按节点数、优先级、价格、随机或外部服务选择。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "--expander"
      }), " 支持逗号分隔的策略链，前一个策略留下并列结果时，才交给后一个策略。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "--max-nodes-total"
      }), " 限制集群总规模；", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "--max-nodes-per-scaleup"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "提交扩容与节点注册",
      children: "提交扩容与节点注册"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Expander 选出方案后，executor 计算 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "NewSize - CurrentSize"
      }), "，调用："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["如果 provider 支持 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "AtomicIncreaseSize"
      }), " 且配置要求原子扩容，CA 先尝试这个接口；否则调用普通的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "IncreaseSize"
      }), "。这一步通常只提交云侧目标规模，实例创建、Node 注册和 Ready 都在后续异步完成。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "后续循环会看到云侧已经创建、但尚未注册到 Kubernetes 的实例，并把它们作为 upcoming nodes 放入快照。这些节点有两个作用："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ol, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "pending Pod 不会因为新节点尚未注册而被重复触发扩容。"
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "这些节点不会被当成可删除的普通节点。"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "缩容流程",
      children: "缩容流程"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["缩容由 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "core/scaledown"
      }), " 下的几个组件共同完成："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(Mermaid, {
      chart: "flowchart TD\n    A[候选节点] --> B[Eligibility.FilterOutUnremovable]\n    B --> C{低于利用率阈值?}\n    C -- 否 --> X[记录不可缩容原因]\n    C -- 是 --> D[RemovalSimulator.SimulateNodeRemoval]\n    D --> E{普通Pod能否搬走?}\n    E -- 否 --> Y[BlockedByPod / NoPlaceToMovePods]\n    E -- 是 --> F[记录Unneeded时间并扣减PDB可中断数]\n    F --> G{持续时间、MinSize、资源下限满足?}\n    G -- 否 --> Z[继续观察]\n    G -- 是 --> H[NodesToDelete]\n    H --> I[taint + drain + 二次检查]\n    I --> J[DeleteNodes]\n"

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "core/scaledown/eligibility/eligibility.go"
      }), " 会先排除这些节点："]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "节点已经被标记为删除；"
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["节点带有 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-down-disabled=true"

      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {

          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n        nodeCPU, nodeMemory := resourcesForNode(node.Node())\n        availCPU := nodeCPU.MilliValue() * ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "int64"
        }), "(option.NodeCount)\n        availMemory := nodeMemory.Value() * ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "int64"
        }), "(option.NodeCount)\n        wastedCPU := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "float64"
        }), "(availCPU-requestedCPU.MilliValue()) / ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "float64"
        }), "(availCPU)\n        wastedMemory := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "float64"

          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "float64"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"

          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " || wastedScore < leastWastedScore {\n            leastWastedScore = wastedScore\n            leastWastedOptions = []expander.Option{option}\n        }\n    }\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {

      }), " 更低，因此最终只保留 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "small"

          }), _jsx(_components.td, {

              children: "cloudprovider/"
            })]
          }), _jsx(_components.td, {
            children: "taint 后二次检查、NodeGroupForNode、DeleteNodes 和云 API 状态"

            }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
              children: "utils/daemonset/"
            })]

          })]
        })]
      })]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["扩容沿着“Pod → 模板 → 调度检查 → estimator → expander → executor → provider”追踪；缩容沿着“资格 → 利用率 → 持续时间 → 模拟搬迁 → PDB/资源/最小规模 → drain → provider 删除”追踪。两条链都从 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "StaticAutoscaler.RunOnce"
      }), " 进入，但判断依据不同。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "总结",
      children: "总结"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "扩容时，CA 先检查待调度 Pod 能否放到各个 NodeGroup 的模板节点。binpacking 根据模拟结果计算节点数，expander 选择 NodeGroup，executor 最后调用 provider 扩容。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "缩容从低利用率检查开始，但节点还要满足持续时间、冷却期、NodeGroup 最小规模和集群资源下限，并通过 Pod 搬迁模拟。节点上有 DaemonSet Pod 不会直接阻止缩容，不过它默认计入利用率；删除节点时是否主动驱逐，还要看 DaemonSet eviction 配置。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["core flags 用来选择 provider 和扩缩容策略；provider 自行读取云平台或 ConfigMap 中的配置；节点模板交给 scheduler framework 模拟调度；", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "cluster-autoscaler-status"
      }), " 只记录运行状态。实现新 provider 时，必须保证 Node 与 NodeGroup 的对应关系稳定、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "TemplateNodeInfo"
      }), " 与实际节点一致，并且能够删除 CA 指定的节点。"]
    })]
  });
}
function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
function _missingMdxReference(id, component) {
  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
